owner_discovery_rule: owner_files is the machine-authoritative active Second Shift lane set. Controllers/workers enumerate it; PROSE child work routes through BOOK and no SYSTEM_MASTER root worker exists.
job_lock_rule: Before dispatch, every delegation must conform to SYSTEM-PROGRAM-JOB-LOCK-001 and SYSTEM-COMPLETION-STATUS-001. A delegation that crosses another peer system's product job, routes Prose to Documents, or claims completion of a non-Prose system is stale/invalid and must not dispatch.
system_lane_rule: CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS are the active peer worker lanes. PROSE is the completed active Book child specialist and inherits BOOK scheduling/claim/telemetry; it has no separate lane.
portfolio_rule: The portfolio controller reads CURRENT-AUTHORITY, the program job lock, completion status, current obligation registry and every owner file. It rejects stale/non-open/cross-lane work before dispatch and preserves independent lane progress.
day_shift_rule: When an active owner materially changes objective or completion standing, reconcile its delegation in the same working session. BOOK reconciliation includes PROSE child integration; DOCUMENTS must never absorb Prose.
night_start_rule: Freshly re-read CURRENT-AUTHORITY, program job lock, completion status, obligation registry and live owner heads before the shift; never trust stale daytime snapshots.
dispatch_rule: Dispatch only job-conforming READY/CANDIDATE work. Knowledge Recovery is supporting CORE work and may use spare safe capacity but must not preempt or block independent BOOK, LEARNING or DOCUMENTS progress.
claim_rule: Only one mutation-capable claim/lease may be live per active owner lane. PROSE child work shares BOOK's claim.
retry_rule: Transient dependencies receive finite classified retries; after exhaustion select independent safe work within the same owner job.
stale_rule: No job survives a live-head, current-obligation, job-lock or completion-status mismatch. Preserve evidence/checkpoint, re-evaluate, then bind a current delegation.
no_work_rule: An active peer lane may be idle only after durable all-eight-rungs exhaustion for its own locked job. A blocker in another lane does not justify idling an independent lane.
successor_rule: After completion/material block, re-read live authority and select the next dependency-valid successor inside that lane's locked job; do not cross into another peer's work.
utilization_rule: Active ledgers are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. PROSE activity is recorded under BOOK. Historical standalone Prose/root ledgers remain evidence only.
